goal: Allow the GUI to connect to an already running node process over IPC instead of spawning one
Let users start and stop the graphical interface independently without stopping the node daemon
reviewability: The PR is ready but sits at the tip of the multiprocess stack on top of #10102, #29409, and #19460
agreement: Concept approval for connecting the GUI over IPC and option naming consistency (laanwj, meshcollider)
Verified remote GUI connection over an SSH tunnel (Sjors)
Nonblocking objection: GUI aborts when spending with an external signer over IPC (Sjors)
Nonblocking objection: node crashes if GUI connects without -disablewallet to a walletless node (jimhashhq)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it lets users attach and detach the graphical interface to a running node on demand
It advances the multiprocess architecture by decoupling the GUI lifecycle from the node process

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it makes signal disconnect eagerly destroy callbacks and their associated state
It prevents proxy object lifetimes from causing node shutdown hangs on exit
